He is the captain of Gujarat Lions in the Indian Premier League, and was the vice-captain of the Chennai Super Kings.  He has also captained the Indian cricket team and is the second-youngest player ever to captain India.  He is the first of the three Indian batsmen to ever score a century in all three formats of international cricket.
Akshdeep Nath | Akshdeep Deependra Nath (born 10 May 1993) is an Indian cricketer who plays for Uttar Pradesh in Indian domestic cricket.  He is a right-hand batsman and occasional right arm medium pace bowler.  He was the vice-captain of the India Under-19 cricket team that won the 2012 ICC Under-19 Cricket World Cup in Australia.  In February 2017, he was bought by the Gujarat Lions team for the 2017 Indian Premier League for 10 lakhs.
Shivil Kaushik | Shivil Sharma Kaushik (born 7 September 1995) is an Indian first-class cricketer who plays for Hubli Tigers in Karnataka Premier League and Gujarat Lions in Indian Premier League.
Rising Pune Supergiant | The Rising Pune Supergiant (often abbreviated as RPS) was a franchise cricket team based in Pune, Maharashtra, that played in the Indian Premier League in 2016 and 2017.  The team along with Gujarat Lions featured as two-season replacements for Chennai Super Kings and Rajasthan Royals, who were suspended due to their involvement in illegal betting by their respective owners.
